shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat, mountain-top rivers with waterfalls, island-aware logistics, vanilla-exact formation goto, cross-level everything, CE support, elevators, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB (sky-view only).
- Selection survives column view switches. Pocket maps: celestial/climate via GROUND map; fog-mesh self-heal on first view.
- **MOUNTAIN RIVER HYDROLOGY (user spec 2026-07-24, round 8):** per contiguous under-mountain stretch: ANY inflow crossing (water flowing INTO the rock) -> vanilla tunnel, untouched. ALL-outflow crossings (river ORIGINATES under the mountain, water only flows away) -> LIFT: ground sealed to solid rock (matching stone edifice + rough floor + thick rock roof, "mountain closed to its boundary"), river head carved on the SKY level (water + banks + rim unfog), waterfall lips where the sky channel meets the mass edge, pouring into the still-wet surface river below. No flow data: single-crossing stretch = source (lift); multi-crossing = through (vanilla, safe). Interpretation on record: through-rivers (in one side, out the other) have inflow -> stay vanilla tunnels; ONLY mountain-source rivers lift.
- **AUTO SKY GENERATION (user-authorized):** player home maps qualifying under the same classifier (roof-footprint variant, run before any sky exists) auto-generate their sky level right after map gen (MapGenerator postfix + ExecuteWhenFinished deferral; gates: IsPlayerHome, mountainRivers setting, LevelGen guard, no existing sky). Waterfalls exist from landing.
- All levels are real maps. Viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop. SKYLIGHTS REMOVED (round 7; postmortem in pass 16).

## RIVER REWORK v3 (this pass) — built compile-green, UNTESTED
GenStep_ABSkyRivers: stretch flood-fill (CollectStretches) + hydrology classifier (ShouldLift: crossings dotted with outward dir, thresholds ±0.2) + SealGroundCell (rock species sampled from flanking stone -> tile rock -> granite; bridged/built-over cells left alone) + carve/banks/rim/lips/flow-copy as v2 (flow-optional). Shared classifier powers GroundQualifiesForAutoSky (roof-based mass predicate). LastSummary reports lifted vs kept-vanilla stretch counts. AutoSkyGen.cs = the MapGenerator postfix. River diagnostic relabeled: wetUnderMass is BY DESIGN nonzero for through-tunnels; lifted source stretches read 0.

## VERIFIED THIS SESSION
- **RMB cross-level: USER-VERIFIED.** **Basement: USER-VERIFIED** ("tests good" — prior behavior restored, fog self-heal active, starter stairs).
- Root-caused chain this marathon: selection wipe -> ReplayFresh; missing disableSkyLighting (reverted with skylight removal) + stale fog bake (self-heal KEPT); empty riverFlowMap variants (flow-optional); pocket-map celestial reads (ground-map rule).

## DEV DIAGNOSTIC SUITE
AB: ensure sky + basement (starter stairs) · AB: basement diagnostic · AB: river diagnostic (LastSummary + live counts, spec-aware labels) · AB: light diagnostic · AB: RMB diagnostic.

## Test plan (next round — needs a map whose river qualifies)
1. Fresh quicktest: if the tile has a mountain-SOURCE river, the sky auto-generates at landing (no dev tool): verify falls off the mass edge, sealed rock below, surface river continuing from the base. River diagnostic: "lifted N mountain-source stretch(es)... kept M through-tunnel(s) vanilla".
2. A through-river map: tunnel intact, NO sky river, no falls (vanilla) — diagnostic: "all kept vanilla".
3. Then the standing stack: below lighting from above, animal flow, direct-to-blueprint, BAM, Batch B/C, perf-mod smoke, translation audit, soak, publishing.

## FEATURE LEDGER
RMB 1:1 parity (VERIFIED) · basement behavior (VERIFIED) · direct-to-blueprint hauling · below-level lighting (sky view) · animal flow fix · BAM compat · perf pass + perf-mod audit · mountain rivers v3 (hydrology spec + auto sky gen) · Batch A verified · Batch B/C built pending. SKYLIGHTS REMOVED.

## Compat
(unchanged) + Better Architect Menu. Perf mods audited. INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## Status
2026-07-24 (17th pass): **river hydrology v3 per explicit user spec (source-lift + through-vanilla + ground seal + auto sky gen) built compile-green**; asset manifest reconciled. Awaiting relaunch on a qualifying tile.
